name: smwmusic-crash-nitro-kart-thunder-struck-desert-storm
title: Crash Nitro Kart - Thunder Struck / Desert Storm
description:
An intense and ominous theme that plays in Thunder Struck, a mountainous track set in a storm. It also plays in Desert Storm, a battle arena based on Out of Time.

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want to use:
0 - Default in-game version
1 - In-game version but with the addition of the drum intro from CTR Nitro-Fueled (0x0CF8)
2 - In-game version but with the addition of the drum intro and the guitar riff from 1:17 to 1:39 from CTR Nitro-Fueled (0x0DD0)

Note: By default, all versions of this song are incompatible with thunder, blargg and Yoshi sound effects and the vanilla bonus end jingle. You can disable the echo in the txt file to make them compatible.
